messages.subject: Caspian v Harburn — draft directions and CMC (8 May)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

Ahead of the CMC on 8 May, please find our proposed directions and a covering letter attached. In summary: DRD by 5 June, Extended Disclosure by 17 July, witness statements by 11 September, single quantum expert each, PTR in December and a 5-day trial in the window commencing 18 January 2027. We renew our suggestion of a one-day mediation in June/July.

James Osei

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Osei — broadly agreed on the timetable, subject to two points on the disclosure models which we'll raise at the CMC. Our client is willing to mediate in July. We'll file agreed directions where we can.

Alistair Whitlock
